Class MediaController

java.lang.Object
arkheim.server.infrastructure.api.controllers.MediaController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/media") public class MediaController extends Object
Controller for managing uploaded media files, including registration, linking to posts, and deletion.

    • registerMedia

      @PostMapping public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<Media> registerMedia(@RequestBody RegisterMediaRequest request)
      Registers a new uploaded media item in the database. HTTP Method: POST Endpoint: /api/media
      Parameters:
      request - the registration details containing file URL, dimensions, size, and uploader UUID
      Returns:
      ResponseEntity containing the registered Media entity

    • linkMediaToPost

      @PostMapping("/{mediaId}/link/{postId}") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<Void> linkMediaToPost(@PathVariable UUID mediaId, @PathVariable UUID postId)
      Links an existing media file to a specific post. HTTP Method: POST Endpoint: /api/media/{mediaId}/link/{postId}
      Parameters:
      mediaId - the UUID of the media
      postId - the UUID of the post
      Returns:
      ResponseEntity with HTTP 200 status

      @DeleteMapping("/{mediaId}/link/{postId}") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<Void> unlinkMediaFromPost(@PathVariable UUID mediaId, @PathVariable UUID postId)
      Unlinks a media file from a specific post. HTTP Method: DELETE Endpoint: /api/media/{mediaId}/link/{postId}

    • deleteMedia

      @DeleteMapping("/{mediaId}") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<Void> deleteMedia(@PathVariable UUID mediaId)
      Deletes a media entry from the database. HTTP Method: DELETE Endpoint: /api/media/{mediaId}
      Parameters:
      mediaId - the UUID of the media to delete
      Returns:
      ResponseEntity with no content (HTTP 204)

    • uploadMedia

      @PostMapping("/upload") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<Media> uploadMedia(@RequestParam("file") org.springframework.web.multipart.MultipartFile file, @RequestParam(value="uploadedBy",required=false) UUID uploadedBy)
      Uploads a media file to the server and registers it in the database. HTTP Method: POST Endpoint: /api/media/upload
      Parameters:
      file - the binary file to upload
      uploadedBy - the optional UUID of the user uploading the file

      Retrieves all media files attached to a specific post. HTTP Method: GET Endpoint: /api/media/post/{postId}
